facts.text: The image is a vertical composite character reference sheet. A large hero image occupies the top, three full-body turnaround views sit in the middle, and four detail close-ups run along the bottom, each with a centered caption.
In the HERO panel, the same person stands full-body on a wet, reflective outdoor walkway at night, flanked by metal railings, with dark buildings and warm distant lights behind.
Visible rain streaks, wet pavement, and specular light reflections establish a rainy nighttime environment in the hero panel.
The person has short dark hair with closely shaved sides and a small topknot at the back; a thin scar or mark is visible above one eyebrow in the FACE close-up.
The outfit consists of a black high-collared tactical jacket with pockets and shoulder/collar straps and buckles, a black shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
The FRONT panel shows the person facing the camera, standing upright with arms relaxed at the sides against a dark charcoal background.
The SIDE PROFILE panel shows the person in a left-facing profile, standing upright, with the small topknot visible at the back of the head.
The BACK panel shows the person from behind, standing with arms at the sides, displaying the jacket back and cargo trousers.
The FACE panel is a head-and-shoulders close-up with the person facing the camera and holding a neutral, serious expression.
The JACKET COLLAR detail shows a high black collar with a zipper and heavy straps fastened by metal buckles.
The HANDS detail shows two bare, weathered hands with visible skin texture and fingers slightly curled.
The BOOTS detail shows black leather lace-up combat boots with side straps and buckles.

The visual treatment is low-key and cinematic: cool desaturated blue-gray rain light and warm amber practical lights in the hero panel, with softer directional studio light in the turnaround and detail panels.
The lower turnaround and detail panels use a dark charcoal studio-like backdrop, distinct from the rainy outdoor hero setting.

card.summary: A cinematic character reference sheet for a tactical-clad adult, combining a rainy nighttime hero shot with front, side, and back turnaround views and close-up details of the face, jacket collar, hands, and boots.

subjects.descriptor: Tactical-clad adult with East Asian facial features, short dark hair, and weathered hands.

card.environment: Rainy nighttime urban walkway with metal railings and distant city lights in the hero panel; dark charcoal studio-like backdrop in the turnaround and detail panels.
card.lighting: Low-key cinematic lighting. Hero: cool rainy ambient light with warm amber practical lights and wet reflections. Turnaround/detail: soft directional studio light against a dark background.
card.framing: Composite sheet: large full-body hero image at top; three full-body turnaround panels in the middle; four detail crops along the bottom; centered labels beneath each panel.
card.style: Photorealistic cinematic concept-art character reference sheet; low-key, gritty, high-detail.
card.characterisation: Gritty, grounded tactical character; severe neutral expression and practical black gear.
card.camera: Mixed framing: wide full-body hero shot, full-body turnaround views, and close-up detail crops.

limitations: Small clothing hardware, fabric texture, and exact scar shape are partly obscured by shadow and image resolution.
The sheet provides visual views and labels but no character name, biography, or narrative context.
As a still reference sheet, it cannot establish motion, camera movement, sound, music, voice, or dialogue.
